Methodology: Fixed seed; independent brute-force geometry and point-distance oracles; complete result-ID/multiplicity and ray/neighbor-distance checks before and after each measured round. Build/input/oracle/check/statistics are outside query timing. Each index materializes the same exact results into preallocated reusable Lists with one QueryContext; no per-query sorting is added unless required by the API. A full warm-up precedes timing. Median elapsed time and median per-thread allocated bytes across rounds; full GC before each sample outside timing. Diagnostic node/primitive counts use a separate untimed pass. Build operations count indexed objects; update operations count moved objects (RTree uses two API calls: Delete+Add). Updates use precreated old/new bounds. Cold move-object uses a fresh index each round; optional steady-move-object alternates forward/backward moves on one tree after two warm cycles, validating outside both timed halves. Static structures do not appear in update rows. Box and precise triangle raycasts are different workloads. KD radius and sorted kNN use a separate point dataset and materializing scan baselines. No concurrency or GPU claims. Shared-host timings are not universal rankings.
